_why: Split In Batches has no `options.reset`, so the phase-2 wave re-entering through `Limit Candidates` is treated as a continuation of the already-exhausted phase-1 set. The whole wave leaves on branch 0 (done) and never reaches `Enrichlayer Profile Fetch`. Measured in production 3 of 3 expansions: waves of 21 / 20 / 45 fresh URLs, 86 candidates found and discarded. A regression from the 2026-09-17 change that enabled phase 2 for the 20-tier, which now pays 6 extra SerpAPI calls and delivers nothing.
_formatNote: The existing patches in this directory use `parameterEdits` with find/replace on a string parameter. That cannot express this change: `options.reset` does not exist yet, so there is nothing to find. `parameterSets` sets an absent nested key instead, and carries `expectBefore` so the test fails loudly if the live baseline ever already has the key.

_whyThisExpression.loopBack: Input from `Stream Batch Done`, whose node code returns { batchDone: true, itemIndex, __phase2 }. So the expression is FALSE and the node continues its current set - the loop advances normally.
_whyThisExpression.newWave: Input from `Limit Candidates`, which carries SERP result objects with no `batchDone` key. So the expression is TRUE and the node treats the input as a new set - which is exactly what phase 2 needs.
_whyThisExpression.trapAvoided: A constant `true` would reset on EVERY call, including every loop-back, so the loop would never advance. The n8n type definition is `reset?: boolean | Expression<boolean>` - 'the node starts again from the beginning of the input items'. 'Just add reset: true' is wrong.
